name: Ulycia Shell Ardihina
original_name: ユリシア・シェル・アルディヒナ
source:
Yulicia is the queen of Roana. Being so young, she still lacks the proper dignity required in her position.However, Yulicia immensely loves her kingdom and the people, and she's willing to do anything for them.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20031206133506fw_/http://www.gamelexgs.com:80/gameinfo/new/2001/0126_card_of_distiny/index.htm]Gamelex[/url]]
translation:
Yulicia is the queen of Roana. Being so young, she still lacks the proper dignity required in her position.However, Yulicia immensely loves her kingdom and the people, and she's willing to do anything for them.
